mapper.select: SELECT "uuid" , side , ord_type , price , state , market , created_at , volume , remaining_volume , reserved_fee , remaining_fee , paid_fee , "locked" , executed_volume , trades_count FROM tb_order_result WHERE state = #{state} ORDER BY created_at DESC;
